messages:
Maya: quick design check — I'm about to push the min/max + burst control updates to the panel branch. Before I do, can we run an accessibility & copy pass? Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see 'capacity-controls_v3')
Devin: 2 quick things I noticed: the burst toggle currently has label 'Allow burst' — feels vague. Maybe 'Allow temporary burst capacity' or 'Enable burst capacity (temporary)'?
Tara: +1 on clarifying. Also the stepper for min/max doesn't announce units — screen readers currently read just 'stepper 3' which is confusing. We should add aria-label e.g. `aria-label="Min GPUs per pool"` and for max `aria-label="Max GPUs per pool"`.
Aiden: UX nit: the SLO slider knob color fails WCAG AA at small sizes against the track when disabled. Contrast needs to be >=4.5:1 for interactive focus states. Could we swap the disabled knob to #6B7280 and keep focus ring at #0EA5A0?
Samira: Copy: pool dropdown currently shows 'auto' for pools with autoscale. Users thought it meant 'automatic selection' rather than 'autoscale enabled'. Suggest 'Autoscale: On' as the inline chip label.
Devin: For keyboard flow — tab order gets stuck in tooltip for the burst info icon. Tooltip should be non-focusable (role=tooltip) and only show on hover/focus of the icon trigger, but focus should move past it with one tab.
Maya: Good calls. For burst wording I'm leaning to 'Enable temporary burst capacity' + inline small helper text: 'Allows short-term scale above max when demand spikes; charged at burst rate.' Keep helper terse.
Tara: Accessibility: make the +/- steppers buttons have aria-controls pointing to the numeric input and an `aria-live=\"polite\"` region announcing 'min updated to X' for screen readers. That helps users who rely on SR for live changes.
Aiden: Also re: GPU pool selector — keyboard users should be able to type to filter names; ensure `role=combobox` with `aria-autocomplete='list'`. Right now it treats as plain listbox which doesn't support type-to-filter.
Samira: Small copy tweak on SLO guardrail tooltip: current copy 'Keep requests within SLO' → change to 'We’ll limit traffic to meet this SLO; requests may be routed to lower-cost pools.' Longer but clearer. Maybe shortened to 'Limit traffic to meet SLO (may use fallback pools)'.
Maya: Action items I hear: (1) Devin/Tara update aria labels and live region patterns; (2) Aiden update contrast + focus states; (3) Samira update inline copy and dropdown chip; (4) I’ll update Figma copy and push branch for review. Assigning owners in thread.
Devin: I can pick up aria labels and live region patterns today. Will open a PR with examples.
Tara: I’ll handle the keyboard/combobox adjustments and tooltip focus behavior.
Aiden: I’ll do color tokens + focus ring updates, and include contrast tests in visual regression.
Samira: I’ll draft the new copy variants and put them in Figma text styles — will add alt phrasing for short vs long helper contexts.
ui-bot: Created design-task-458 in Asana and linked the Figma file. Due 2026-04-02.
Maya: thanks team — please drop PR links here when ready. Also ping me if any of the changes affect Dedicated console (we should keep parity). :thumbsup:
Devin: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8921 (aria labels + live region)
Tara: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8925 (combobox + tooltip behavior)
Aiden: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8930 (color tokens + focus)
Samira: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8934 (copy variants in Figma + tokens)
Maya: Reviewing now. Will do a quick accessibility smoke on staging after merges. If anything is blocking parity with Dedicated, flag it in the PR. Thanks!
Devin: noted — will add a small compatibility checklist in the PR description.
Tara: ran quick keyboard test on staging — combo focus now works, but arrow-down on closed combobox should open the list. I’ll add that to the PR tests.
Aiden: visual tests added to the PR. Focus ring size adjusted to 3px to meet visibility goals.
Samira: updated helper copy in Figma; left an alt short version for compact cards.
Maya: thread resolved? If no objections I’ll merge once CI passes.
Devin: no objections from me.
Tara: good from me.
Aiden: fine.
Samira: good to merge.
Maya: merging after final CI — thanks everyone! :party_face:
